name: BASH!
instructions: omr/instructions/42073-1-1.pdf (one book: pull-back motor and rear axle in the first steps, front lever steps 10-22, wheels steps 49-52, functions page 52)

functions.does: The rear wheels turn together on the axle through the pull-back motor: pulled back along the ground they wind it up, and let go the motor drives the car forward.
functions.source: book: first steps (motor and rear axle), page 52 (right insets: pull back, let go)

functions.does: The front wheels roll freely on their axle.
When the car runs into a wall, the red lever sticking out low at the front is knocked back, and its upright arm flicks the loose bonnet block up off the car.
functions.source: book: page 52 (left inset: the bonnet flying off as the car hits; lower right inset: the car hitting the wall); front steps 10-22; how the lever reaches the block is inferred from the model
functions.note: The bonnet block (p129 88646, p132 3701, p137 2431 and the parts under them) only sits on the car by two pins and is meant to fly off.

functions.does: The pull-back motor's spring drives the car once it is wound and let go.
functions.skip: a spring; only matters under force
